entries.original: Stable soak waived by operator: "Operator-approved by Peter for 2026.9.6: soak-only live/E2E lanes not run (release_profile=beta, run_release_soak=false per 2026.9.5 precedent); 2026.9.5 to 2026.9.6 update proven via the upgrade-survivor and published-upgrade-survivor lanes, install smoke, and the first-hop compat lane."
entries.translated: 운영자에 의해 Stable soak 면제: "Peter가 2026.9.6 버전에 대해 승인함: soak 전용 라이브/E2E 레인은 실행되지 않음 (2026.9.5 전례에 따라 release_profile=beta, run_release_soak=false 설정); 2026.9.5에서 2026.9.6으로의 업데이트는 upgrade-survivor 및 published-upgrade-survivor 레인, install smoke, first-hop compat 레인을 통해 검증되었습니다."

entries.original: Operator lane waiver: "2026.9.6 Operator lane waiver approved by Peter (2026-09-23, \"release this now\"): non-proof CI, plugin and release-check lane failures are advisory for the 2026.9.6 stable; artifacts, install smoke, upgrade survivors and pack budget stay required."; waived lanes: normalCi checks-node-agentic-control-plane-agent-chat (failure); normalCi checks-node-bundle-infra-small-runtime-2 (failure); normalCi openclaw/ci-gate (failure)
entries.translated: 운영자 레인 면제: "Peter가 2026.9.6 운영자 레인 면제를 승인함 (2026-09-23, \"지금 바로 릴리스\"): non-proof CI, 플러그인 및 release-check 레인 실패는 2026.9.6 stable 버전에 대해 권고 사항입니다. 아티팩트, install smoke, upgrade survivors 및 pack budget은 필수 유지 항목입니다."; 면제된 레인: normalCi checks-node-agentic-control-plane-agent-chat (실패); normalCi checks-node-bundle-infra-small-runtime-2 (실패); normalCi openclaw/ci-gate (실패)
